briefdescription.para: Specialisation of DMat for ARingZZpFlint matrices, backed by FLINT's nmod_mat_t.

detaileddescription.para: Wraps a FLINT nmod_mat_t and forwards every dense matrix operation to FLINT's nmod_mat_* routines, so the coefficient-by-coefficient arithmetic uses FLINT's optimised nmod primitives. RAII-clean: the constructor calls nmod_mat_init and the destructor calls nmod_mat_clear.
